description: This source file defines the interface 'PipelineFunction' and its inner interfaces 'Signature' and 'ParameterDefinition', which describe a pipeline function including its signature, parameter definitions, and execution method. It also contains string patterns for quoted string content but no implementations.

classes.name: PipelineFunction
classes.description: An interface representing a pipeline function, including methods for obtaining function name, signature, executing the function, and inner interfaces for signature and parameter definitions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature object of the function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the function with given input value, parameters including parentheses, and an expression resolver, returning a processed PipelineElement.

methods.name: renderSignature
methods.description: Generates a string describing the function's signature in a human-readable form (default method in Signature interface).

methods.name: getParameterDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter definitions for the function signature.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the class/type of the parameter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the parameter.
